items.t: 25th Navajo Nation Council honors Fort McDowell Yavapai Nation’s Orme Dam victory FORT MCDOWELL, Ariz. — On Saturday, members of the 25th Navajo Nation Council joined the Fort McDowell Yavapai Nation for its 45th annual Orme Dam Victory Days Parade, celebrating the Yavapai people’s historic victory in protecting their ancestral homelands.
